requirement: The system shall allow users to enter candidate names and their vote totals or import tally data from XML files, and use the submitted data for electoral seat allocation.

The system shall allow users to view and select supported electoral methods and calculate seat allocations from the submitted tally data, including majority methods (simple, qualified, and absolute), ranking by votes, equal proportions (Huntington-Hill), largest remainder methods (Hare, Droop, and Imperiali), and highest averages methods (D'Hondt, Sainte-Lague/Webster, Imperiali, and Danish).

The system shall allow users to view available tally-processing and result-processing options, set allocation parameters and rules or load them from a configuration file, and apply the chosen settings when calculating results.
The system shall allow users to view allocation results and save tally data, allocation results, and allocation settings to output files, including the supported XML formats.
The system shall notify the user or calling application when seat allocation cannot be completed, clearly distinguishing a failed calculation from a successful allocation result.
